name: jev-kit
description: Jev-powered tools for Claude Code: cheap typed judgments about files without reading them into context.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Key Jev is called with, through OpenRouter. Create one at https://openrouter.ai/keys

max_files_per_call.title: Max files per call
max_files_per_call.description: ask_jev_files refuses, before any Jev call, a pattern that matches more files than this.

max_tokens_per_call.title: Max tokens per call
max_tokens_per_call.description: ask_jev_files refuses, before any Jev call, a pattern whose files add up to more estimated tokens than this.

max_usd_per_session.title: Max USD per session
max_usd_per_session.description: Every tool refuses once Jev has cost this much in the current Claude Code session.
